fact: The Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs has validated the Lettre de Politique Sectorielle (LPS) aligned to the SND 2025-2029; the National Digital Observatory is managed by the ministry's CEP and its rebuild is in the 2026 work plan of the World Bank-financed PAENS.
title: Passation des Marchés de Services de Consultants - Termes de Référence de l'Observatoire National du Numérique (ONN)
publisher: PAENS / Ministère des Télécommunications et du Numérique
